title: Story premise EDU089: The Route Has More Than One Sense
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: What if the announcement is not available to you? Takeaway/theme: Important wayfinding information can be offered through complementary modes.
description: A museum wants visitors to find a gallery, but directions rely only on a spoken announcement. A co-designed prototype pairs clear text, visual landmarks, and other appropriate cues so visitors can choose useful information.
